blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Camera-based 3D object detection and online vectorized HD mapping provide compact scene representations for autonomous driving, but both depend on accurate metric geometry and remain limited by depth ambiguity. Over long-term deployment, observations from repeated traversals can be accumulated into persistent point cloud priors that provide geometric context beyond the current observations. Existing explicit point cloud prior approaches, however, rely on LiDAR-based map construction and therefore require expensive 3D ranging sensors. We propose a framework that constructs a static point cloud prior map from previous camera traversals using Pi3X and augments each point with DINOv3 features. At runtime, a local prior patch is retrieved using global localization, encoded with a sparse voxel backbone, and fused in bird’s-eye view (BEV) with lifted multi-view camera features. Task-specific sparse transformer heads then predict 3D objects and vectorized map elements from the fused representation. On Argoverse 2, the vision-based prior improves a strong baseline from 0.287 to 0.299 CDS and from 0.669 to 0.750 vectorized mapping mAP. Ablations show that semantic DINOv3 features are particularly important for vectorized mapping. These results demonstrate that vision-built geometric-semantic priors provide an effective form of long-term scene memory for camera-based perception, improving both tasks without LiDAR for prior-map construction or online inference.
blocks.zh: 基于相机的3D天体探测和在线矢量HD映射为自主驾驶提供了紧凑的场景表现,但两者都依赖于准确的度量几何,并且仍然受到深度模糊的限制. 在长期部署期间,从反复的曲面观测结果可以累积成持续点云前缀,提供超出当前观测的几何背景. 然而,现有的显点云前置方法依赖于基于LiDAR的地图构造,因此需要昂贵的3D测距传感器. 我们提出一个框架,用Pi3X从以前的相机转盘构造一个静点云前图,并用DINOv3的特性增强每个点. 在运行时,使用全局本地化检索本地先前的补丁,编码为稀疏的 voxel 骨干,并装入鸟眼视野(BEV),具有解除的多视图相机特性。 任务特定的稀疏变压器头然后从引信的表示中预测3D对象和矢量化的映射元素. 在Argoverse 2上,基于视觉的先导改进了一个强基线,从0.287到0.299 CDS,从0.669到0.750矢量映射mAP. 缩写显示语义DINov3特征对于矢量化映射特别重要. 这些结果表明,视觉构建的几何语义前传为相机感知提供了一种有效的长期场景内存形式,改进了没有LiDAR的两种任务,用于前传地图构建或在线推论.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Camera-based 3D object detection and online vectorized HD mapping are central to autonomous driving, as they provide the object- and map-level scene representations required for downstream prediction and planning [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . LiDAR-only and camera–LiDAR fusion methods [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 ] achieve strong performance by exploiting accurate 3D geometry, but require expensive ranging sensors at inference. Camera-only approaches [ 11 , 12 , 13 , 14 , 1 , 15 ] are more scalable and retain rich semantic and high-resolution visual cues, yet remain fundamentally challenged by depth ambiguity [ 16 , 17 ] . This is particularly limiting for vectorized mapping, where the model must infer static map structure despite occlusions caused by traffic participants and other scene elements [ 9 , 15 , 18 , 19 ] .
blocks.zh: 基于相机的3D天体探测和在线矢量HD映射是自主驾驶的核心,因为它们提供了下游预测和规划[1,2,3]所需的对象和地图级场景表现. LiDAR-只和相机 – LiDAR 聚变方法 [4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10]] 通过利用准确的3D几何技术实现强性能,但在推论中需要昂贵的测距传感器. [11,12,13,14,1,15] 仅摄像头方法更具有伸缩性,保留丰富的语义和高分辨率视觉提示,但仍受到深度模糊性的根本挑战[16,17]. 这对矢量化绘图特别有限制,尽管交通参与者和其他场景要素造成隔离,模型必须推断静态地图结构[9、15、18、19]。

blocks.en:
During long-term deployment, autonomous vehicles repeatedly traverse the same environments including under open-set conditions [ 20 , 21 ] , allowing observations across multiple agents and previous traversals to be accumulated into a persistent spatial prior with broad coverage. This accumulated prior map can then be retrieved for online perception to incorporate geometric prior knowledge as a complementary source beyond the current observations.
Previous work has exploited such priors for 3D occupancy prediction using neural rendering-based maps [ 22 , 23 ] or global occupancy maps [ 24 ] . PreSight [ 22 ] additionally applies its reconstructed prior to vectorized mapping, but requires computationally heavy per-scene NeRF optimization. For 3D object detection, Hindsight [ 25 ] uses prior LiDAR maps for LiDAR-based perception, while AsyncDepth [ 26 ] and DualViewMapDet [ 27 ] introduce LiDAR-map priors for camera-based 3D object detection. While these detection methods demonstrate the value of previous-traversal geometry for 3D detection, existing explicit point cloud priors for camera-based methods are still constructed from LiDAR traversals.
blocks.zh:
在长期部署期间,自主飞行器反复穿越相同的环境,包括在开放的设定条件下[20,21],使跨越多种物剂的观测和以往的转动得以累积到一个具有广泛覆盖的持久空间。 然后可以检索到这个累积的先前地图,以便在线感知,将几何以前的知识作为当前观察之外的补充来源。
以前的工作利用这些前科,利用基于神经渲染的地图[22、23]或全球占用地图[24]进行3D占用预测。 前视[22]在矢量化映射前额外应用其重建,但需要计算重的每层NERF优化. 对于3D对象检测,Hindsight [25] 使用之前的LiDAR地图进行基于LiDAR的感知,而Async Depth [26] 和 DualViewMapDet [27] 引入了基于相机的LiDAR-映射对象检测. 虽然这些检测方法证明了前传的三维检测几何学的价值,但现有的基于相机方法的显点云前传仍然从LiDAR Travers构造.

blocks.en: In this work, we investigate whether an explicit point cloud prior can instead be built from previous camera traversals without LiDAR-based mapping and benefit both 3D object detection and vectorized mapping. We construct such a prior using the feed-forward Pi3X reconstruction model [ 28 ] and augment each reconstructed point with dense DINOv3 features [ 29 ] . The resulting geometric-semantic representation combines metric scene structure with image-derived semantic features in a common 3D map. The reconstructed geometry provides context that can reduce depth ambiguity for 3D object detection, while the accumulated prior retains information about static map elements that may be occluded in the current observations.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们调查是否可以在不使用基于LiDAR的绘图的情况下,从先前的相机转录器中先建一个明确的点云,并有利于三维物体探测和矢量化绘图。 我们使用向导的 Pi3X 重建模型[28] 并用密集的 DINov3 特性加固每个重建点[29] 。 由此形成的几何语义表达法将测量场景结构与图像衍生的语义特征结合到共同的3D地图中. 重建后的几何提供了可以降低3D对象探测深度模糊度的上下文,而积存的先前保留了关于静态地图元素的信息,这些元素可能在当前观测中被占用.

blocks.en: Fig. 1: Camera-map perception with a vision-built prior. Given multi-view images and the current ego pose, we retrieve a local DINOv3-augmented point cloud reconstructed from earlier camera traversals. The prior map is encoded into bird’s-eye view (BEV) and fused with lifted image features. Task-specific transformer heads then predict 3D bounding boxes and vectorized HD map elements from the fused BEV features.

blocks.en: We propose a camera-based framework that retrieves a local patch from a global vision-built prior map, encodes it with a sparse voxel backbone, and fuses it with camera BEV features obtained through LSS lifting [ 30 ] , as shown in Fig. 1 . The fused representation is decoded with SparseDrive-style transformer heads [ 1 ] for 3D object detection and online vectorized HD mapping, while perspective-view (PV) image features remain available to both heads through PV deformable aggregation. At inference, our method requires only calibrated multi-view RGB cameras, global localization, and access to the offline prior map. No LiDAR is required for map construction or online perception. Experiments on Argoverse 2 show improvements for both tasks, with particularly strong gains in vectorized mapping when the prior is enriched with DINOv3 features. These results demonstrate the potential of persistent cross-traversal priors to improve perception during subsequent visits using information accumulated over long-term deployment.
blocks.zh: 我们提出一个基于相机的框架,从全球视觉构建的地图上取回局部补丁,用稀疏的Voxel骨干编码,并将其与通过LSS升起[30]获得的相机BEV特性连接起来,如Fig所示. 1 (英语). 引信表示器用SparseDrive风格的变压器头[1]进行解码,用于3D物体检测和在线矢量化HD映射,而透视(PV)图像特性通过光电变形聚合仍可供两个头使用. 推论,我们的方法只要求校准多视图的 RGB 相机,全球本地化,以及访问离线前图. 地图构建或在线感知不需要LiDAR. 在Argoverse 2上的实验显示,这两项任务都有改进,在前一项具有DINOv3特性后,在矢量化绘图方面特别显著。 这些结果表明,在以后的访问中,利用长期部署期间积累的信息,长期交叉性前科有可能改善人们的看法。

blocks.en: II Technical Approach
blocks.zh: 二. 技术办法

blocks.en: Fig. 2: Overview of our approach. Multi-view images are encoded into perspective-view (PV) features and lifted to BEV via LSS, while a locally built vision-based point cloud prior is retrieved at the ego location and encoded by a BEV point cloud encoder. The camera and map BEV features are fused in a shared metric space. Sparse transformer heads for 3D detection and vectorized mapping then sequentially aggregate fused BEV features and multi-view PV image features.
blocks.zh: 费格。 2:概述我们的做法。 多视图图像被编码成透视(PV)特性,并通过LSS被提升到BEV,而本地建造的基于视点云之前在自负位置被检索,由BEV点云编码器编码. 相机和地图BEV的特性被融合在一个共享的公尺空间中. 用于3D检测和矢量化映射的Sparse变压器头,然后依次集成已熔化的BEV特性和多视图PV图像特性.

blocks.en: We propose a camera-based framework for joint 3D object detection and vectorized mapping that exploits an offline static point cloud prior map reconstructed from previous camera traversals (Fig. 2 ). At inference, the model requires calibrated multi-view RGB images, a globally localized ego pose, and retrieval of a local prior-map patch. Unlike previous prior-map methods based on LiDAR [ 26 , 27 ] , neither map construction nor online perception requires LiDAR sensing to enable scalable deployment.
blocks.zh: 我们提出一个基于相机的三维物体联合探测和矢量映射框架,利用离线静点云前图从之前的相机转盘重建(图2). 推论,该模型需要校准多视图的RGB图像,一个全球本地化的自负姿势,以及检索本地前图补丁. 与之前基于LiDAR的地图方法[26,27]不同,地图构建和在线感知都要求LiDAR感知才能实现可伸缩部署.

blocks.en: II-B Vision-Based Prior Map Construction and Retrieval
blocks.zh: II-B 基于愿景的先期地图建造和检索

blocks.en: We use Pi3X, the enhanced π 3 \pi^{3} feed-forward reconstruction model [ 28 ] , to build the prior map from camera data. Given a set of input images, Pi3X jointly predicts camera poses and intrinsics, local 3D point maps, and point confidences. Each local point map assigns every image pixel a 3D point in the coordinate system of the corresponding camera. We process each sequence in chunks of 12 multi-view frames and transform the local point maps from all cameras and time steps into a common global frame using the dataset-provided camera poses. The transformed point maps are then concatenated to accumulate all point clouds for a chunk.
blocks.zh: 我们使用Pi3X,增强的 \ 3\ pi\ 3} feed-forward 重建模型 [ 28] , 从相机数据中构建先前的地图 。 鉴于一组输入图像,Pi3X联合预测了相机的姿势和内在,局部的3D点地图,以及点的置信度. 每个局部点地图在相应相机的坐标系统中指定每个图像像素一个3D点. 我们用12个多视图帧块处理每个序列,并利用数据集提供的相机将所有相机和时间步骤的局部点地图转换成共同的全球帧。 变形点图随后被调整,以积累所有点云为块.

blocks.en: Because the reconstruction scale can vary across chunks, we recover metric scale using the dataset trajectory. Specifically, we estimate a scale factor from the displacement between the first and last Pi3X-predicted poses and the corresponding dataset-provided global poses, α = ∥ 𝐭 K G − 𝐭 1 G ∥ 2 ∥ 𝐭 ^ K − 𝐭 ^ 1 ∥ 2 , \alpha=\frac{\lVert\mathbf{t}^{G}_{K}-\mathbf{t}^{G}_{1}\rVert_{2}}{\lVert\hat{\mathbf{t}}_{K}-\hat{\mathbf{t}}_{1}\rVert_{2}}, (3) and apply α \alpha to the predicted local depth before transforming the reconstructed points into the global coordinate frame using the dataset-provided camera poses. Hence, the Pi3X-predicted poses are used only to recover metric scale, while the dataset poses establish the relative alignment between frames and the global reference frame.

We retain points with a Pi3X confidence score of at least 0.5 0.5 , remove points closer than 0.6 m 0.6\text{\,}\mathrm{m} to their corresponding camera or farther than 60 m 60\text{\,}\mathrm{m} , and mask out dynamic objects using projected 3D boxes. The remaining static points are average-pooled in 0.2 m 0.2\text{\,}\mathrm{m} voxels and stored in a tiled global map as in DualViewMapDet [ 27 ] .

blocks.en: II-D Sparse Detection and Mapping Heads
blocks.zh: II-D 薄片检测和绘图头

blocks.en: We follow the symmetric sparse perception design of SparseDrive [ 1 ] , augmented with the sequential BEV–PV deformable aggregation [ 27 , 11 ] . The detection branch maintains 3D box anchors A d ∈ ℝ M d × 11 A^{d}\in\mathbb{R}^{M_{d}\times 11} and instance features F d ∈ ℝ M d × C F^{d}\in\mathbb{R}^{M_{d}\times C} , while the mapping branch represents anchors as polylines L m ∈ ℝ M m × N p × 2 L^{m}\in\mathbb{R}^{M_{m}\times N_{p}\times 2} with corresponding instance features F m ∈ ℝ M m × C F^{m}\in\mathbb{R}^{M_{m}\times C} [ 1 ] . In each decoder layer, both branches first aggregate the fused BEV representation and then the multi-scale PV image features: 𝐟 i ′ \displaystyle\mathbf{f}^{\prime}_{i} = 𝐟 i + BEV ​ - ​ DeformAgg ​ ( 𝐟 i , 𝐚 i , 𝐅 BEV ) , \displaystyle=\mathbf{f}_{i}+\mathrm{BEV\text{-}DeformAgg}(\mathbf{f}_{i},\mathbf{a}_{i},\mathbf{F}_{\mathrm{BEV}}), (10) 𝐟 i ′′ \displaystyle\mathbf{f}^{\prime\prime}_{i} = 𝐟 i ′ + PV ​ - ​ DeformAgg ​ ( 𝐟 i ′ , 𝐚 i , { 𝐅 img c , s } ) . \displaystyle=\mathbf{f}^{\prime}_{i}+\mathrm{PV\text{-}DeformAgg}(\mathbf{f}^{\prime}_{i},\mathbf{a}_{i},\{\mathbf{F}^{c,s}_{\mathrm{img}}\}). For detection, deformable keypoints are sampled from the 3D anchor box. For mapping, the polyline points serve as the geometric sampling locations. This exposes both tasks to the metric camera–map context in BEV while retaining fine-grained image information in PV.

blocks.en: III Experimental Evaluation
blocks.zh: 三. 实验评价

blocks.en: We evaluate our method on Argoverse 2 to quantify how vision-built prior accumulated across previous traversals affects camera-based 3D object detection and online vectorized HD mapping. We compare against strong camera-based baselines under standard evaluation protocols and ablate the contributions of prior geometry and DINOv3 semantics.
blocks.zh: 我们在Argoverse 2上评价我们的方法,以量化先前跨过之前的曲面积聚的视觉如何影响基于相机的3D物体检测和在线矢量HD映射. 我们比较了标准评价协议下的强相机基线,并减轻了以前的几何学和DINOv3语义学的贡献。

blocks.en: III-A Implementation and Training Details
blocks.zh: 执行和培训细节

blocks.en: The image backbone produces multi-scale features at strides { 4 , 8 , 16 , 32 } \{4,8,16,32\} , and the camera and map BEV branches use a shared 128 × 128 128\times 128 spatial grid. We lift stride- 8 8 PV features to 480 × 704 480\times 704 resolution and stride- 16 16 features for the higher-resolution setting. Following our baselines, VoVNet-99 [ 34 ] is initialized from FCOS3D pretraining on nuScenes. We train for 80 epochs with AdamW, a base learning rate of 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} , cosine decay, and a 500-iteration warm-up. The batch size is 24, and we use sequential iteration training. Image and BEV/3D augmentations follow [ 11 ] . The LSS depth estimator is supervised with LiDAR depth during training, while inference remains camera-based. We additionally employ image–map grid masking [ 27 ] .
III-B Dataset and Metrics
blocks.zh: 数据集和计量

blocks.en: Argoverse 2 [ 36 ] provides synchronized surround-view cameras and repeated coverage of urban areas, enabling prior-map construction from other traversals. Training maps are built exclusively from the training split. For validation, maps may contain training and validation traversals, but never the current traversal. We use the globally corrected Argoverse 2 poses from DualViewMapDet [ 27 ] . For 3D detection, we report the official Composite Detection Score (CDS), mAP, and true-positive errors mATE, mASE, and mAOE over the 26 classes. Vectorized mapping is evaluated with mAP following the protocol used by StreamMapNet [ 37 ] and MapTracker [ 15 ] .
blocks.zh: Argoverse 2 [36] 提供同步围观摄像机,并反复覆盖城市地区,使得能从其他横道上进行前图建设. 培训地图完全通过培训分期制作。 为了验证,地图可能包含培训和验证的曲面,但从未包含目前的曲面. 我们使用来自DualViewMapDet的经过全球校正的Argoverse 2姿势[27]. 对于3D检测,我们报告官方综合检测分数(CDS),mAP,以及真阳性错误mATE,mASE,mAOE在26个班级上. 矢量映射在StreamMapNet[37]和MapTracker[15]使用的协议之后,通过mAP进行评价.

blocks.en: Tab. I compares our method with detection-only, mapping-only, and joint perception baselines. Under the directly matched 480 × 704 480\times 704 SparseDrive setting, the vision-based prior improves detection from 0.287 to 0.299 CDS and from 0.381 to 0.396 mAP, while reducing mATE from 0.709 to 0.696 and mAOE from 0.668 to 0.641. The gain is substantially larger for vectorized mapping, where mAP increases from 0.669 to 0.750. Thus, although the reconstructed map is less geometrically accurate than a LiDAR prior, its accumulated static structure and semantic features provide useful context for both object- and map-level perception.
blocks.zh: 标签。 我比较了我们的方法 与检测,绘图, 和联合感知基线。 在直接匹配的480×704 480\时的704 SparseDrive设置下,基于视觉的先期检测改进了从0.287到0.299 CDS和从0.381到0.396 mAP的检测,同时将MATE从0.709减少到0.696,mAOE从0.668减少到0.641. 矢量化绘图的收益要大得多,其中mAP从0.669增加到0.750. 因此,虽然重建的地图比LiDAR之前的几何精确度要低,但其累积的静态结构和语义特征为对象和地图水平感知提供了有用的上下文.

blocks.en: III-D Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 三-D 阅读研究

blocks.en: Prior map and DINOv3 features: Tab. II isolates the contribution of the prior representation. Geometry alone slightly improves mapping mAP from 0.669 to 0.683, but does not improve detection, indicating that noisy camera-reconstructed geometry is not sufficient by itself. Augmenting the points with DINOv3 features raises detection to 0.291 CDS/0.388 mAP and mapping to 0.756 mAP. The particularly large mapping gain indicates that semantic foundation-model features provide strong cues for static structures such as lane dividers, road boundaries, and pedestrian crossings. Using prior maps from all prior traversals instead of only the two traversals with the largest point clouds per tile further improves detection to 0.299 CDS and 0.396 mAP, while mapping remains comparable at 0.750 mAP.
blocks.zh: 前图和 DINov3 特性 : 标签。 二是孤立先前代表的贡献。 仅几何就略微改进了mAP的映射,从0.669到0.683,但没有改进探测,表明吵闹的相机重构几何本身是不够的. 将带有DINOv3特性的分数提升到0.291 CDS/0.388 mAP,将映射到0.756 mAP. 特别大的测绘收益表明,语义基础模型特征为诸如车道划分器、道路界限和行人过境等静态结构提供了强有力的提示。 使用所有之前的曲面图,而不是每个瓦片最大点云的两个曲面图,将探测率进一步提高到0.299 CDS和0.396 mAP,而绘图仍然可比于0.750 mAP.

blocks.en: Map coverage: Not every validation sequence has equally strong prior coverage. We therefore evaluate subsets with increasing overlap and re-evaluate the map-free baseline on exactly the same samples in Tab. III . The prior remains beneficial on all subsets, and the CDS improvement is larger on the coverage-restricted subsets ( + 1.8 +1.8 – 1.9 1.9 pp) than over the full validation set ( + 1.2 +1.2 pp), confirming that reliable previous-traversal coverage is important for exploiting the map prior.

blocks.en: IV Conclusion
blocks.zh: 四. 结论

blocks.en: We presented a framework for joint camera-based 3D object detection and online vectorized HD mapping that constructs a persistent geometric-semantic point-cloud prior from previous camera traversals. Pi3X geometry is enriched with DINOv3 features, encoded in BEV, and fused with camera features before sparse task-specific decoding. Experiments on Argoverse 2 show consistent gains over a strong SparseDrive-style baseline, with the largest improvements for vectorized mapping when semantic DINOv3 features are included. These results show that observations accumulated over long-term deployment can be retained as an explicit cross-traversal spatial prior and improve perception during subsequent visits, without requiring LiDAR for prior-map construction or online inference. In future work, we aim to improve camera–map fusion through better spatial alignment in BEV and stronger alignment of the two modalities in feature space. We will further investigate map change detection to increase robustness to outdated prior maps and to automatically identify when map updates are required.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个基于相机的三维物体联合探测和在线矢量化HD映射的框架,这个框架在以往相机横贯之前就构建了持久的几何-语义点-云. Pi3X几何丰富了DINOv3的特性,在BEV中编码,在稀少的任务特定解码之前与相机特性结合. 在Argoverse 2上的实验显示,相对于一个强大的SparseDrive式基线,在纳入语义DINov3特征时,矢量化绘图的改进最大。 这些结果表明,长期部署过程中积累的观测结果可以保留为明确的交叉前空间,并在后续访问中改善感知,而不需要LiDAR进行前图构建或在线推论. 在今后的工作中,我们的目标是通过改善BEV空间的对接和在特征空间对两种模式的更紧密的对接,改进相机-地图组合。 我们将进一步调查地图更改探测情况,使以往的地图更加坚固,并自动确定何时需要地图更新。
